ops.statement: The commander spine feedback step writes durable files (AGENT_FEEDBACK entry + apply_lessons_delta --file .agent-work/LESSONS.md) via paths that, post-PR-#84 durable_root resolution, land in the MAIN checkout's canonical files. For a solo commander that is correct; for a worktree commander under an ACTIVE Admiral epic those canonical files are Admiral-owned mid-epic, and mechanical write-through both (a) races a concurrent wave-sibling commander's append and (b) bottom-appends AGENT_FEEDBACK, breaking its newest-on-top order. The feedback imperative should gain an explicit under-epic/delegated branch: when a launch order is in force, stage the AGENT_FEEDBACK entry and lessons-delta worktree-local in the work-id archive for the Admiral's harvest rather than writing through to canonical.
